title: Just David
author: Eleanor H. (Eleanor Hodgman) Porter
longDescription: Porter is a children's novel published in 1916. When young David's reclusive father dies, the violin-playing boy must adapt to village life with adoptive parents, unable to even recall his own last name.

authorInfo.bio: Eleanor H. (Eleanor Hodgman) Porter (1868–1920) is the author of Just David. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
